tools.name: security_preflight
tools.description: Run a $1 static Security Preflight and return a signed receipt. New x402 payer wallets may receive the fleet-wide $0.01 introductory call. No deployed endpoint is fetched or tested. Importing the receipt into an Agent Market profile is a separate, explicit action.

subject_profile_sha256.description: Current Agent Market profile_sha256. Required only for ranking-eligible Market import.

tools.name: get_security_receipt
tools.description: Read a previously issued public, input-redacted receipt.

tools.name: describe_agent
tools.description: Describe scope, evidence boundary, inputs, and outputs.

tools.name: scan_source
tools.description: $1 bounded inline VulnCanon source scan. Up to 64 KiB, 2000 lines and 4096 characters per line. Indicators, not proven exploits; no model calls, fetching or code execution. Redacted signed receipt. No introductory discount.

tools.name: screen_injection
tools.description: $1 batch of 1–20 samples screened for deterministic injection markers. Up to 8192 characters per sample and 64 KiB total. Indicators, not calibrated probabilities or safety guarantees. No model calls or introductory discount.
